description: This source file defines the CLIInstaller enum which provides static methods for managing the installation and location of the openclaw CLI tool within a macOS environment. It includes functions for checking installation status, finding installation location, performing installation via shell scripts, and parsing installation events.

methods.name: installedLocation
methods.description: Returns the file path of the openclaw CLI if installed, otherwise nil. Checks provided preferred search paths.

methods.name: installedLocation(searchPaths:fileManager:)
methods.description: Searches provided search paths for the openclaw executable that is not a directory and is executable.

methods.name: isInstalled
methods.description: Returns true if openclaw CLI is installed, false otherwise.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Performs installation of openclaw CLI, updating the provided statusHandler with progress messages.
